description: Shared test vectors for scripts.py (pytest) and static/schema.js (node test_ota.mjs). Each case: script, shared, expected errors (exact strings). methods: firmware/config/methods.json.

cases.name: blink too fast
errors: call 1 (config.set): led.blink_hz: must be at most 10

cases.name: bad enum
errors: call 1 (config.set): led.mode: must be one of off, blink, heartbeat

cases.name: integer required
errors: call 1 (config.set): update_interval_ms: must be an integer

cases.name: string not number
errors: call 1 (config.set): adv_interval_ms: must be an integer

cases.name: below minimum
errors: call 1 (config.set): update_interval_ms: must be at least 1000

cases.name: read-only method not scriptable
errors: call 1 (device.info): not allowed in a config script

cases.name: per-device method in shared config
errors: call 2 (board.set_id): per-device method; set it on the node, not in a shared config

cases.name: per-device method allowed when not shared
params not an object
errors: call 1 (config.set): params: must be an object

cases.name: not a script
errors: script must be an object with a "calls" list

cases.name: call without method
errors: call 1: must be an object with a "method" string

cases.name: two errors
errors: call 1 (config.set): led.blink_hz: must be at least 0.1
call 1 (config.set): adv_interval_ms: must be at most 10240
